description: Provenance figure: distance from residue 20-beta to the bound purine base across experimental structures and the two Dictyostelium AlphaFold models
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np

# Provenance figure: measured vs modelled distance of the residue-20beta position to the guanine base
labels = ['pig G-SCS\nGln20β\n(2FP4, GTP)',
          'T. aquaticus\nPro20β\n(3UFX, GDP)',
          'E. coli\nPro20β\n(1CQI, ADP)',
          'Dicty scsB\nGln46\n(AF model)',
          'Dicty scsC\nPro54\n(AF model)']
# 3UFX: four copies; 1CQI: Pro20 not within 4 A, measured directly below
vals  = [2.58, np.mean([6.15,5.56,5.77,5.59]), None, 2.59, 5.68]
errs  = [0,    np.std([6.15,5.56,5.77,5.59]),  0,    0,    0]
kind  = ['experimental','experimental','experimental','model','model']
spec  = ['GTP-specific','prefers GTP','prefers ATP','predicted','predicted']
cols  = ['#2f6f4e','#2f6f4e','#8c3b3b','#2f6f4e','#8c3b3b']

import requests
aa3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
t=requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CQI.pdb',timeout=120).text
A=[]
for ln in t.split('\n'):
    if ln.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')):
        try: A.append((ln[12:16].strip(),ln[17:20].strip(),ln[21],int(ln[22:26]),
                       float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
        except: pass
ade={'N1','C2','N3','C4','C5','C6','N6','N7','C8','N9'}
d1cqi=[]
for ch,num in sorted(set((a[2],a[3]) for a in A if a[1]=='ADP')):
    L=np.array([[a[4],a[5],a[6]] for a in A if a[1]=='ADP' and a[2]==ch and a[3]==num and a[0] in ade])
    P=np.array([[a[4],a[5],a[6]] for a in A if a[2]==ch and a[3]==20 and a[1] in aa3to1])
    if len(P) and len(L): d1cqi.append(float(np.sqrt(((P[:,None,:]-L[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min()))
print('1CQI Pro20beta -> adenine base min distances:', [round(x,2) for x in d1cqi])
vals[2]=float(np.mean(d1cqi)); errs[2]=float(np.std(d1cqi))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(labels))
bars=ax.bar(x, vals, yerr=errs, capsize=4, color=cols,
            edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.7,
            hatch=['','','','//','//'])
ax.axhline(3.5, color='#444444', ls='--', lw=1)
ax.text(len(labels)-0.45, 3.62, 'hydrogen-bonding range', fontsize=8.5, ha='right', color='#444444')
for xi,v in zip(x,vals): ax.text(xi, v+0.22, f'{v:.2f} Å', ha='center', fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8.8)
ax.set_ylabel('min distance from residue 20β to the purine base (Å)')
ax.set_ylim(0,7.4)
ax.set_title('Gln20β contacts the base; Pro20β sits back from it in enzymes of both preferences.\nscsB reproduces the Gln contact, scsC the Pro gap (hatched = AlphaFold model, not experiment)',
             fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
